# WebCrawlers

> WebCrawlers offers a founder-led AI visibility audit and agreed repair pilot for one small
> business website. Adam works with the owner to inspect up to 30 pages in one
> language, agree on a few changes, approve release, and review the affected
> live pages. Setup and the repair sprint are quoted separately. Rankings,
> AI mentions, traffic, and sales are not guaranteed.

Contact: hello@webcrawlers.tech

The current public offer is an Adam-led audit and repair pilot. Content work is scoped separately. Public customer sign-in and subscriptions are not available in this offer.

## Pages

- [About us](https://webcrawlers.tech/about): founder-led AI visibility audits and agreed repairs, founded by Adam Krestol
- [Project inquiry](https://webcrawlers.tech/start): business, website, goals and contact details
- [Example deliverable](https://webcrawlers.tech/example): dated own-site email-link repair, coverage and measurement limits
- [Privacy](https://webcrawlers.tech/privacy): inquiry information and contact for data requests
- [Service details](https://webcrawlers.tech/service): scope, quotes, access and publication

- [Home](https://webcrawlers.tech/): pilot scope, quote approach, and contact form (also in [Hebrew](https://webcrawlers.tech/he/), [German](https://webcrawlers.tech/de/), [French](https://webcrawlers.tech/fr/), [Polish](https://webcrawlers.tech/pl/), [Swedish](https://webcrawlers.tech/sv/))
- [What is GEO?](https://webcrawlers.tech/what-is-geo): definition, GEO vs SEO, and practical website checks
- [How it works](https://webcrawlers.tech/how-it-works): the supervised pilot process and current software status
- [Pilot pricing](https://webcrawlers.tech/ai-visibility-audit-pricing): separate setup and delivery quotes
- [FAQ](https://webcrawlers.tech/faq): pilot scope, approvals, pricing, and measurement limits

- [AI visibility audit](https://webcrawlers.tech/ai-visibility-audit): scope, checks, measurement and how to start
